## Checklist

- [ ] The change is about versions or keeping VSeerr in step with Seerr.
- [ ] Changes to existing Seerr files are kept as small as possible.
- [ ] Lint, formatting, type checks and tests pass.
- [ ] `pnpm build` succeeds.
- [ ] `pnpm i18n:extract` was run if UI text changed.
- [ ] SQLite and PostgreSQL migrations are included if the database changed.
- [ ] Documentation is updated.
